_comment: The packaged configurations a fresh install can adopt in one press. This file is the AUTHORITY; the setup_picks table is its loaded copy (express_setup.load_packaged, run at every start). Edit here, commit, restart. No ':free' models on purpose: free tiers have spotty-to-no support, and a model that stops answering is the opposite of a bullet-proof setup. A user can pick anything else by hand once the box is running.

picks.label: DeepSeek · Flash
picks.why: The best all-round model tested on this project so far: strong writing, fast, long context, cheap. It is what this install ships expecting.
picks.verified_how: Listed by the provider's own API and accepted as the default on a fresh install (mint-cogitate-test), with Bob and Lois seeded from it. No chat turn was driven on that install yet.

picks.label: OpenRouter · DeepSeek Flash
picks.why: The same family as the DeepSeek pick, through OpenRouter — one key also opens every other model that service carries, so this is the pick for anyone who wants to try others later.
picks.verified_how: Listed and priced in the install's own curated list; not yet driven end to end here.

picks.label: OpenRouter · Qwen 3.7 Flash
picks.why: The long-context workhorse: 1M context at about $0.03/M in. A sound second choice behind a DeepSeek key.
picks.verified_how: Listed and priced in the install's own curated list; not yet driven end to end here.

picks.label: OpenRouter · GPT-OSS 120B
picks.why: OpenAI's open 120B through OpenRouter — cheap, capable, a different family to fall back on if the DeepSeek line ever lets you down.
picks.verified_how: Listed and priced in the install's own curated list; not yet driven end to end here.

picks.label: Ollama Cloud · Nemotron 3 Super
picks.why: A large reasoning model on a keyed service, for anyone already using Ollama Cloud. The free usage tier is metered, so treat it as a stopgap rather than the plan.
picks.verified_how: Listed in the install's own curated list; not yet driven end to end here.
